title: Mail Catalog Shipping Credit on the OTC Quarter Load
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit, mail catalog program.** A catalog shipping credit is added to the member's quarter load of the over-the-counter allowance according to the member's mail catalog and online ordering in the previous loaded quarter.

**Rule.** The catalog shipping credit counts the mail catalog and online orders tagged to the previous loaded quarter: four dollars ninety-five ($4.95) for two or more such orders, two dollars fifty ($2.50) for exactly one, and nothing for none.

The previous loaded quarter is the benefit quarter of the latest allowance load already on the member's pharmacy coverage when the new load is booked. The orders counted are the purchases tagged to that quarter in the allowance activity whose channel is mail catalog or online; retail pharmacy purchases are not counted.

### Credit table

| Mail catalog and online orders tagged to the previous loaded quarter | Catalog shipping credit added to the quarter load |
|---|---|
| Two or more | $4.95 |
| Exactly one | $2.50 |
| None | Nothing |

### Examples (hypothetical)

- One mail catalog order and one online order in the previous loaded quarter: two orders, $4.95.
- One online order and three retail purchases: one order, $2.50.
- Retail purchases only: nothing.
